notes.title: Free Major Expansion - ‘Butcher’s Banquet’ - is Available Now!
notes.content:
You’ve been more patient than a professional sniper awaiting that perfect shot. But get ready to pull the trigger, as the wait is finally over… 

As of today, all versions of [i]Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2[/i] will now include ‘Butcher’s Banquet’: a major expansion which introduces an entirely new, unexplored region - The Temple - complete with all-new objectives and some of your most deadly contracts, yet. In addition, today’s patch also added Chinese VO to the main game. Check out the dramatic trailer below…

[previewyoutube=BSWOpPK05oY;full][/previewyoutube]
The stunning desert-like area, made up of luscious oases, dramatic waterfalls, and mysterious temples, might look picturesque, but make no mistake - it’s no holiday destination. Following the recent turmoil in Kuamar, a new threat has been allowed to surface. The movement is led by the notorious Mahmoud Zarza... aka ‘The Butcher’. Unpredictable and incredibly dangerous (hence the monika), we need you to eliminate him and his equally-lethal associates, and in doing so, put a stop to the faction's rapid uprising… as only you know how. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/8de3ae82835f569ebe0cf2a1d8a14e800043d094.png[/img]

For those of you who haven't yet picked up [i]Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2[/i], get 25% off now for a limited time only as part of Steam's Midweek Madness offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/79a2ea6d7d349826216818e14265d9ee0fee8379.png[/img]

In other news, new DLC also dropped today! Designed in direct collaboration with CYRILmp4, one of Europe’s leading FPS content creators, this latest Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 DLC weapon skin pays tribute to the sharpshooter’s super-sleek monochrome branding. 

A master with the sniper rifle, Cyril’s known to his community for his insanely accurate aim, and while his branded weapon skin might not grant you the same level of precision, at least you can look almost as good as the deadeye-streamer while lining up that headshot! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/58100cc337c3df8e9235969e9955fb244906a2b0.png[/img]

[h3]Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]1000m+ extreme-range sniping
[*]A dramatic single-player campaign set in modern-day Middle East, with 5 distinct sandbox maps featuring a variety of fully accessible, interactive areas players can approach their own way
[*]Next-level realism with realistic gadgets and weapons customizable to fit different styles of play
[*]Replayable missions that can be completed in a number of ways, with unlockable rewards for achieving all objectives
[*]More intelligent adversaries with improved tactics
[*]Next-generation features including enhanced visuals, 4k resolution, and improved loading times, setting a new benchmark as the best looking Sniper Ghost Warrior game thus far
[/list]

For more information about Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2, head to www.SniperGhostWarriorContracts2.com, follow the team on [url=https://www.facebook.com/SniperGhostWarrior]Facebook[/url], or join the conversation on [url=https://twitter.com/SGWContracts]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://discord.gg/U9B26ZNsjp]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: SGW Contracts 2 - V1.03 - HUD Customisation, Game Improvements & More!
notes.content:
Greetings, snipers!

With today’s update, we’re introducing several killer adjustments and improvements to the game. Here’s what we’ve done:

[h3]Added various HUD customization options, so you can now:[/h3]
[list]
[*] disable all HUD elements completely - great for taking screenshots and admiring the games beauty
[*] disable the wind indicator & bullet drop in your scope
[*] disable the map / enemy radar found in the bottom left corner of your screen
[*] disable hitmarkers
[*] disable gore independently from blood
[/list]
[h3]Difficulty changes
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Automatic health generation on 'Dead Eye' difficulty has been disabled
[*] Automatic health generation on 'Sniper Veteran' difficulty has been slightly decreased
[/list]
[h3]Challenges[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved displaying challenge descriptions in all supported languages
[*] The "Kill everyone in the village without raising the alarm and rescue Taj Taheer" challenge is now unlocked properly, even after loading the game
[/list]
[h3]Other improvements, tweaks & bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game will now indicate when an enemy spotter sees you with their binoculars, similar to snipers
[*] Removed one enemy in the Mount Kuamar region that sometimes spawned inside walls. You're a free man again Gary!
[*] AI will recognise the player quicker in close range
[*] AI will react faster to grenades thrown
[*] Enemy AI should no longer spawn in the player's field of vision on rare occasions.
[*] The Road in Ronald Payne's outpost no longer flickers during Bullet Cams
[*] Improvements to ambient audio in caves
[*] Improvements to various player animations
[*] Fixed various instances in which a player could get stuck between objects
[*] Jammers and spotlights functionality has been made more consistent
[*] Fixed rare issue in which part of the Mount Kuamar region was not being loaded properly
[*] Additional performance and stability improvements
[*] Various bug & typo fixes.
[/list]
If you have any problems with the update, don’t hesitate to contact us at support@cigames.com.

While you’re at it, make sure to share your amazing screenshots with us on [url=https://twitter.com/SGWContracts]Twitter[/url] and on our [url=https://discord.gg/SGW]Discord.gg/SGW[/url].

Thank you again for playing!

Watch your six, and keep an eye out for patrols.

notes.title: Wreak Carnage with New Crossbow DLC & Safari Skins
notes.content:
SGW Contracts 2 is a week old today, and no doubt, you’ve obliterated enough heads to repaint the entire town red. But why not give the ol’ sniper rifle a couple of days off, in favour of an all-new tool of destruction - the crossbow! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/f4b17b943766809d41a275f0be5c42a537ea5d61.png[/img]

Released today, the Crossbox Carnage DLC pack contains the following four new weapons and weapon skin:[list]
[*] Crossbow - compatible with three different types of ammo, including the spectacular explosive bolt, no self-respecting assassin is complete without it 

[*] Model 550 TRV - light and nimble, this weapon is quick to aim and even quicker to fire

[*] Mad Sheriff 9 - it’s a revolver… but has dreams of being a shotgun, with the ability to shoot both bullets and buckshots at unexpecting foes

[*] Car K8 - enjoy steady recoil in full automatic mode. Ah yeahhhh. 

[*] Zeb-bruh (weapon skin) - Because stripes never go out of fashion 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/f2efb907abb89e74546674f14737af9ce0efa025.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587590/Sniper_Ghost_Warrior_Contracts_2__Crossbow_Carnage_Weapons_Pack/

In addition, we also released four new DLC weapon skin packs, all inspired by the fierce and untamed animal kingdom.
[list]
[*] Safari Sadist - Hunter or hunted? Make sure it’s the former with the Safari Sadist DLC pack, featuring three trapper-themed skins. It’s ideal for snipers who want to blend in before they strike.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/62865d5b3c18446646f85778d7ac8cf906d8e8c7.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587591/Sniper_Ghost_Warrior_Contracts_2__Safari_Sadist_Skin_Pack/
[list]
[*] Claws are Out - Slash, growl and roar your enemies into submission with these three feline-themed skins. Designed to make your armoury purr before you sink a bullet-shaped tooth into your foes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/c9dc388ce6fe4b67ce1fba795649291edd9f0009.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587593/Sniper_Ghost_Warrior_Contracts_2__Claws_are_Out_Skin_Pack/
[list]
[*] Savage Serpents - Lay low in the grass until you’re ready to strike, with these three savage snake-themed weapon skins.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/a73361a39f1e61eb75c4863c9d680ee42f5a8e75.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587592/Sniper_Ghost_Warrior_Contracts_2__Savage_Serpents_Skin_Pack/
[list]
[*] Wild Thing - Release your inner beast and become ruler of the jungle with the Wild Thing DLC pack, featuring three ferocious new weapon skins.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/3a2c911c1c365026d09f3ed0049e15968bf3d18c.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587594/Sniper_Ghost_Warrior_Contracts_2__Wild_Thing_Skin_Pack/

notes.title: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2: Gameplay Trailer Reveal
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Snipers! [/h2]


[h3]Get ready to cast your scopes on your [b][u]very FIRST LOOK[/u][/b] at Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 with our brand-new Gameplay Reveal Trailer![/h3]

[previewyoutube=17fqzmlwqyw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]SGW Contracts 2 elevates the series to  new heights - and distances! - with its 1000m+ extreme-range sniping feature. As contract sniper assassin, Raven,  you must utilize a selection of authentic gear and equipment across large-scale sandbox maps in order to track and eliminate a range of targets… by whatever means necessary. Snipe from afar, or infiltrate silently. Anything but failure is an option. 


[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] 1000m+ extreme-range sniping
[*] A dramatic single-player campaign set in modern day Middle East
[*] 5 distinct sandbox maps featuring a variety of fully accessible, interactive areas you can approach your own way
[*] Next level realism with authentic gadgets and weapons fully customizable to fit different styles of play
[*] Replayable missions that can be completed in a number of ways, with unlockable rewards for achieving all objectives
[*] More intelligent adversaries with improved tactics
[*] Enhanced visual and game engine, setting a new benchmark for the series
[/list]
[/h3]
[h2][b]Releasing on 4th June 2021, don’t miss a beat (or headshot!) by WISHLISTING NOW![/b][/h2]
